text.text_excerpt: What a great option for getting many types of king cake in one place! I know Pythian Market downtown does something similar but parking around there just feels like too much of a pain. This Mid-City location near City Park is a better option in my opinion. This kind of "hub" in general saves you time and is great for the indecisive... no more driving all over town! There is plenty of street parking on/around Canal and it was easy to stop by on my way downtown around 8:00 am on a Wednesday! They're set up outside the haunted house; just a bunch of shelving units and tables with cakes grouped by bakery! I believe they're delivered fresh every morning. There is a refrigerator for the more pe...

King Cake Hub takes out the stress of having to drive to tons of individual bakeries and stores around the city, and places some of the best king cakes you can find all under one roof! They have so many different varieties and flavors. I went on Sunday around 4pm, and one would think that they would be out of some stock, but they still had plenty of selections! They are open every day from 8am-6pm and are totally worth the visit. PS - get the GW Fins pretzels, they are AMAZING and so worth the $$.

The King Cake Hub is awesome!! It's conveniently close (walkable) from my house, which could be dangerous! They have so many options-bakeries and flavors! I visited yesterday and they did have a few of the Eat Fit NOLA king cakes and were getting a delivery today of Girls Gone Vegan cakes (and there were several flavors). They do get daily deliveries and they will hold something for you if you call ahead. The ladies working were very nice and really knowledgeable about all of the different options! I had to pace myself, so for this trip, I purchased a Gambino's cream cheese, the Eat Fit NOLA cake and a satsuma almond NOCCA cake. I'm going to need to go back because I also need the Bywater...
